spec.title: Outbound health
spec.description: DOWN: Xray alive=0. DEGRADED: burst window contains failed probes. UP: alive with no failed probes; ordinary observatory exposes only alive. Missing data stays missing.

spec.title: Target replacements
spec.description: Observed target replacements in a centered 60-second window. Division by two assumes a constant selected-set size and stable inventory; additions/removals can produce half values. The latest centered bucket is incomplete.

spec.title: Outbound selected time
spec.description: Fraction of observed samples in which a target was selected, not its share of traffic. Multiple selected targets can sum above 100%. Missing scrapes do not count as zero.

spec.title: Prometheus target
spec.description: Prometheus can scrape the exporter. Source statuses separately report collection success.

spec.title: Metrics sources
spec.description: API: configuration discovery. gRPC: runtime routing, traffic and process. Expvars: observatory. Disabled sources are absent, not zero.

spec.title: Outbound latency
spec.description: Burst: mean RTT of successful samples in the observation window. Ordinary observatory: last successful delay. Seconds; no fabricated values on failure.

spec.title: Collection duration
spec.description: API collection runs first, followed by gRPC and expvars in parallel. Runtime shows the maximum of their durations. The stacked API + Runtime approximates the collection time; Total is the full scrape duration measured by Prometheus, including processing and network overhead.

spec.title: Balancer outbound availability
spec.description: A selected target or fallback resolves to a runtime outbound. Structural availability, not a test of internet access.

spec.title: Selected target count
spec.description: Number of selected targets. No selection series means no value; it is not synthesized as zero.

spec.title: Burst RTT range
spec.description: Minimum and maximum successful RTT in the current burst window. Not available for ordinary observatory.

spec.title: Burst failed probes
spec.description: Failed fraction in the current burst window, not a cumulative counter. Empty measurements remain absent.

spec.title: Go runtime memory
spec.description: Go runtime memory values; neither is process RSS.

spec.title: GC pause time
spec.description: GC pause seconds per elapsed second, displayed as a percentage.

spec.title: Current outbound health
spec.description: DOWN: Xray alive=0. DEGRADED: burst window contains failed probes. UP: alive with no failed probes; ordinary observatory exposes only alive. Missing data stays missing.

spec.title: Outbound quality metrics
spec.description: P50/P95 are percentiles of observed window means, not individual HTTP requests. Probe success is a sample-weighted estimate over overlapping observation windows, not a count of unique probes.

spec.title: Outbound quality score
spec.description: Dashboard heuristic, not the score used by Xray leastLoad. Burst-only reliability inputs are absent for ordinary observatory. No missing values are filled with zero.

spec.expr:
(
  exp(
    -10 *
    (
      sum_over_time(
        xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound=~"${outbound}"}[$__range]
      )
      /
      sum_over_time(
        xui_observatory_outbound_probe_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound=~"${outbound}"}[$__range]
      )
    )
  )
) ^ 0.50

*

(
  exp(
    -2 *
    (
      quantile_over_time(
        0.95,
        xui_observatory_outbound_rtt_mean_seconds{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound=~"${outbound}"}[$__range]
      )
      -
      quantile_over_time(
        0.50,
        xui_observatory_outbound_rtt_mean_seconds{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound=~"${outbound}"}[$__range]
      )
    )
  )
) ^ 0.30

*

(
  clamp(
    130 -
    100 *
    quantile_over_time(
      0.50,
      xui_observatory_outbound_rtt_mean_seconds{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",outbound=~"${outbound}"}[$__range]
    ),
    0,
    100
  ) / 100
) ^ 0.20

* 100
